text: Actual class level,book/known/prepared entries,components,RP,operator authority and every comparison acquisition must be proved. An accepted interface is not character acquisition.
Exact recorded acceptance/application scope only; differently serialized/edited backing files and historical Conference01 do not promote later changes.
Actual whole-body dimensions,pose,fit,perception/LoE,space,contact,cover and safe access required; missing facts hold whole dependent case/branch.
No actual canonical faction/champion designation supplied by a synthetic token. Whole positive faction campaign case held until institutional,champion and representation-permission evidence exists.
Finite NEW profiles carry no CR,bestiary identity,natural biology,soul,private memories or automatic campaign approval; unsupported profiles remain unavailable.

Actual equipment,body handling,proficiency,compatible weapon/ammunition and borrowing rights remain required. Siege Engineer kit is not a weapon profile or granted proficiency. Unlisted weapons not authored.
Actual ground bearing,geometry,mass,load,terrain/support changes,environment and repair eligibility required. No real-world physics shortcut or unspecified crushing simulation.
Named healing/Null extensions only; actual recipient limits,prohibitions,transfer exclusions and damage/repair eligibility must be present. No generic summon/structure healing.
Real cargo,operator actions,spent ammo,damage,source clock and identity histories persist. Unknown physical settlement remains held,not teleported or erased.
Inherited trauma/dark-content/player-agency limits remain; no compelled belief,automatic institutional authority or silent player-character retirement.
No planes,souls,real lich/champion transport,afterlife or theological facts granted; unknown topology held.
No supplied/historical program or game execution; no runtime or human playtest approval. Synthetic data fixtures do not establish actual campaign content.
No release,global authority,canonical application,domain closure,feat335 reopening or completed cohort redo.
Every original question,scenario,future obligation,source qualification and exact accepted comparison hold remains preserved verbatim in evidence.
